sources.text: English Releases Ministry of Home Affairs 10-August, 2026 17:43 IST Government of India notifies 11 more International Ports, enabling entry of E-Visa holder foreigners into India Total number of International Ports for E-Visa holder foreigners’ entry now goes up to 88 Addition of 11 International Ports further enhances attractiveness and utility of electronic visa, India provides approximately 95% E-visas applications in less than 72 hours Under guidance of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and leadership of Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah, Government has taken a number of significant initiatives over the last few years to liberalize, streamline and simplify visa regime The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports. Addition of 11 International Ports further enhances attractiveness and utility of electronic visa. Notably, India provides approximately 95% E-visas applications in less than 72 hours. Under the guidance of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and leadership of Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah, Government of India has taken a number of significant initiatives over the last few years to liberalize, streamline and simplify visa regime with a view to facilitate the legitimate foreign travelers while simultaneously ramping up the technological infrastructure to enhance internal security. With the latest addition, the total number of International Ports enabling entry of E-Visa holder foreigners has increased to 88, including 37 airports, 38 seaports and 13 land ports. List of International Ports, enabling entry of E-visa holder foreigners in India, as on date- Sl. No. Airports Seaports Landports Ahmedabad Agatti Raxaul Amritsar Alang Rupaidiha Bagdogra Bedi Bandar Darranga Bhogapuram Bhavnagar Jogbani Bengaluru Calicut Agartala (Newly Added) Bhubaneswar Chennai Darranga (Newly Added) Calicut Cochin Gede (Newly Added) Chandigarh Cuddalore Ghojadanga (Newly Added) Chennai Dahej Haridaspur (Newly Added) Cochin Dhamra Jaigaon (Newly Added) Coimbatore Haldia Dawki (Newly Added) Delhi Hazira Moreh (Newly Added) Gaya Kakinada Attari (Road) (Newly Added) Goa (Dabolim) Ennore – Kamarajar Goa (Mopa) Kandla Guwahati Karaikal Hyderabad Kattupalli Indore Kolkata Jaipur Kollam Kannur Krishnapatnam Kolkata Mandvi Lucknow Mormugao Madurai Mumbai Mangalore Mundra Mumbai Nagapattinam Nagpur New Mangalore Navi Mumbai Nhava Sheva Port Blair Paradeep Pune Pipavav Surat Porbandar Thiruvananthapuram Port Blair Trichy Sikka Varanasi Tuna Tekra Vijaywada Tuticorin Visakhapatnam Vallarpadam Bhopal (Newly Added) Visakhapatnam Tirupati (Newly Added) Vizhinjam – Kovalam Vizhinjam Total 37 38 13 E-VISA One significant step taken to liberalize and simplify the Indian Visa regime, especially the tourist visa regime, is the introduction of the e-Visa facility. E-visa facility, with Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), was introduced in 2014 for nationals of 43 countries. This facility is presently available to nationals of 172 countries. E-Visa is presently available under following 17 sub-categories: Sl. No. Category Tourist Mountaineering B-1 B-2 B-3 (Business Visa) B-4 B-5 B-6 M-1 M-2 (Medical Visa) M-3 M-4 S-1 S-2 (Student Visa) Transit X-1 (Miscellaneous) Group Visitor Visa (Cruise) It is pertinent to mention that India now issues roughly 78% visas as Electronic visas. *** RK / RR / PR / PS (Release ID :293125) Tweet

changes.entry_requirements: Carry the printed GRANTED e-Visa approval and the passport linked to it; if travelling on a replacement passport, also carry the old passport. Enter through a designated e-Visa airport, seaport or land port. Check the Ministry of Home Affairs list of eligible ports at https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=293125. Have return/onward travel and sufficient funds; biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival. Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa. For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

visa_products.notes: April–June fee season; non-extendable and non-convertible. An additional 3% bank charge applies to payable eVisa fees.

visa_products.application_channel_detail: Apply online through the official e-Visa portal, upload the required passport page and photograph, and pay any applicable fee. Apply 4–120 days before planned arrival and wait for GRANTED status before travel.

Scanned passport biographical page

Return or onward ticket and sufficient money for the stay
Additional purpose-specific documents if taking an eligible short course, volunteering or other specialised activity

exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.
The e-Visa is unavailable for diplomatic/official passports or non-passport travel documents; each applicant needs an individual passport.
Applicants with a serving or retired defence, military, security or police background must use the regular-visa procedure.
Apply online at least 4 days and up to 120 days before planned arrival; wait for GRANTED status and carry the approval printout.
The 30-day e-Tourist Visa allows multiple entries within the period beginning on first arrival. The 1-year and 5-year tourist permissions have a cumulative 180-day limit per calendar year.

Entry on an e-Visa is restricted to designated airports, seaports and land ports. Check the Ministry of Home Affairs list of eligible ports at https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=293125. Biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival.
The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.
If using a new passport after approval, carry the old passport on which the approval was issued as well.
Check nationality and product-specific fees. A 3% bank charge is added to applicable payable e-Visa fees.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

supporting_evidence.scope_note: Only the designated eVisa entry-port clause. No all-land-crossings claim or unique port count. Prior declaration reviews and retained other conditions remain separately scoped.

The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.
The Government of India has notified 11 more International Ports, enabling E-visa holder foreigners to enter India. The newly added 11 International Ports include 09 land ports and 02 airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Scanned passport biographical page
Recent front-facing photograph meeting the portal requirements
Return or onward ticket and sufficient money for the stay
Additional purpose-specific documents if taking an eligible short course, volunteering or other specialised activity
visa_products.entry_requirements: Carry the printed GRANTED e-Visa approval and the passport linked to it; if travelling on a replacement passport, also carry the old passport. Enter through a designated e-Visa airport or seaport. Have return/onward travel and sufficient funds; biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival. Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa. For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.
exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.
The e-Visa is unavailable for diplomatic/official passports or non-passport travel documents; each applicant needs an individual passport.
Applicants with a serving or retired defence, military, security or police background must use the regular-visa procedure.
Apply online at least 4 days and up to 120 days before planned arrival; wait for GRANTED status and carry the approval printout.
The 30-day e-Tourist Visa allows multiple entries within the period beginning on first arrival. The 1-year and 5-year tourist permissions have a cumulative 180-day limit per calendar year.

Entry on an e-Visa is restricted to designated airports, seaports and land ports. Check the Ministry of Home Affairs list of eligible ports at https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=293125. Biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival.
The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.
If using a new passport after approval, carry the old passport on which the approval was issued as well.
Check nationality and product-specific fees. A 3% bank charge is added to applicable payable e-Visa fees.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

health_requirements.question: Have you travelled in or transited a yellow fever endemic country within the past 6 days?

visa_products.application_channel_detail: Apply online through the official e-Visa portal, upload the required passport page and photograph, and pay any applicable fee. Apply 4–120 days before planned arrival and wait for GRANTED status before travel.
required_documents: Individual ordinary passport with at least 6 months validity when applying and at least 2 blank pages
Scanned passport biographical page
Recent front-facing photograph meeting the portal requirements
Return or onward ticket and sufficient money for the stay
Additional purpose-specific documents if taking an eligible short course, volunteering or other specialised activity
visa_products.entry_requirements: Carry the printed GRANTED e-Visa approval and the passport linked to it; if travelling on a replacement passport, also carry the old passport. Enter through a designated e-Visa airport or seaport. Have return/onward travel and sufficient funds; biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival. Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa. For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.
exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.
The e-Visa is unavailable for diplomatic/official passports or non-passport travel documents; each applicant needs an individual passport.
Applicants with a serving or retired defence, military, security or police background must use the regular-visa procedure.
Apply online at least 4 days and up to 120 days before planned arrival; wait for GRANTED status and carry the approval printout.
The 30-day e-Tourist Visa allows multiple entries within the period beginning on first arrival. The 1-year and 5-year tourist permissions have a cumulative 180-day limit per calendar year.

Entry on an e-Visa is restricted to designated airports, seaports and land ports. Check the Ministry of Home Affairs list of eligible ports at https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=293125. Biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival.
The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.
If using a new passport after approval, carry the old passport on which the approval was issued as well.
Check nationality and product-specific fees. A 3% bank charge is added to applicable payable e-Visa fees.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

entry_requirements.note: AI review of the e-Arrival Card for foreign nationals and the separate Air Suvidha 2.0 declaration for international air arrivals only. Land/sea applicability of Air Suvidha is not established by this evidence. Mandatory before immigration clearance; before-boarding completion is requested, and 24 hours in advance is permissive. No visa/product eligibility, price, policy expiry, grade, or freshnes

supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The 30-day e-Tourist Visa allows multiple entries within the period beginning on first arrival. The 1-year and 5-year tourist permissions have a cumulative 180-day limit per calendar year.

Entry on an e-Visa is restricted to designated airports, seaports and land ports. Check the Ministry of Home Affairs list of eligible ports at https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=293125. Biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival.
The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

seed_entries.note: Verified 2026-08-30. Validity taken from the destination's published figure for this product, separately from the permitted stay. | Verified 2026-08-30 against India's per-country e-Tourist fee schedule, dated 9 July 2026 and linked from the official e-visa portal. required_documents: Individual ordinary passport with at least 6 months validity when applying and at least 2 blank pages

Return or onward ticket and sufficient money for the stay

exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.
The e-Visa is unavailable for diplomatic/official passports or non-passport travel documents; each applicant needs an individual passport.
Applicants with a serving or retired defence, military, security or police background must use the regular-visa procedure.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

visa_products.entry_requirements: Meet the Visa-on-Arrival eligibility criteria and apply at one of the six designated airports. The immigration officer decides the actual grant.
exceptions: Visa on arrival is available only at Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Mumbai international airports.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.

The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.

Check nationality and product-specific fees. A 3% bank charge is added to applicable payable e-Visa fees.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

visa_products.entry_requirements: Carry the printed GRANTED e-Visa approval and the passport linked to it; if travelling on a replacement passport, also carry the old passport. Enter through a designated e-Visa airport or seaport. Have return/onward travel and sufficient funds; biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival. Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa. For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.
exceptions: Travellers of Pakistani origin, including the stated parental or grandparental birth/residence links, must obtain a regular visa through an Indian mission.
The e-Visa is unavailable for diplomatic/official passports or non-passport travel documents; each applicant needs an individual passport.
Applicants with a serving or retired defence, military, security or police background must use the regular-visa procedure.
Apply online at least 4 days and up to 120 days before planned arrival; wait for GRANTED status and carry the approval printout.
The 30-day e-Tourist Visa allows multiple entries within the period beginning on first arrival. The 1-year and 5-year tourist permissions have a cumulative 180-day limit per calendar year.
Entry on an e-Visa is restricted to designated airports and seaports. Biometrics are captured at immigration on arrival.
The e-Visa is non-extendable and non-convertible; protected, restricted and cantonment areas require separate permission.
If using a new passport after approval, carry the old passport on which the approval was issued as well.
Check nationality and product-specific fees. A 3% bank charge is added to applicable payable e-Visa fees.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. supporting_evidence.quote: Foreigners and OCI Card holders can complete and submit the e-Arrival card online within 72 hours before their arrival in India at boi.gov.in or indianvisaonline.gov.in or via official 'Indian Visa Su-Swagatam' Mobile App. This is for arrival information, not a visa.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

verified_elements: Complete the e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival in India at https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/earrival/. This arrival information does not replace a visa.

For international arrivals by air, the Air Suvidha 2.0 health self-declaration is mandatory before immigration clearance. Complete it at https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ before boarding your flight, as requested by the Ministry of Civil Aviation during web check-in. The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL) today launched AIR SUVIDHA 2.0, an upgraded contactless Passenger Health Self-Declaration Portal, to strengthen public health surveillance at Points of Entry in response to the ongoing Ebola disease outbreak.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

Developed in collaboration with the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the portal enables International arriving passengers to submit a mandatory online Health Self-Declaration — covering 21-day travel history, exposure history and related symptoms, if any — prior to immigration clearance.

Airsuvidha Self Declaration Form (SDF) can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival to India. Passengers are requested to fill the forms before boarding of the flight , during web check-in for swift clearance on arrival and only required to show the downloaded SDF at the International Travel Health Desk or Immigration counter.

The form can be completed 24 hours in advance before arrival in India. Show the downloaded declaration at the International Travel Health Desk or immigration counter.
